name: roster
description: Roster coordinates artifact work into a working team, quality loop, tool boundary, and resumable task packets inside the active Codex workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate artifact work with roles, checks, and handoff continuity
interface.longDescription: Use Roster to turn non-trivial artifact work into a clear team shape, task boundary, quality loop, tool-access boundary, and resumable packet trail in the active Codex workspace. Roster does not require a persistent server, daemon, database, or separate orchestration UI.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn these meeting notes into a project plan
Set up the working team and quality checks
Find where this Roster task is blocked
